statements.t: We are therefore raising our 2026 revenue guidance to $46-48 million and maintaining our expectations for full-year Free Cash Outflow of less than $8 million,” he explained.
The Company now anticipates total revenue of $46 million to $48 million for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2026 (“2026”).
The Company continues to anticipate Free Cash Outflow of less than $8 million for 2026.
The webcast will be available for replay on the Company’s website approximately two hours after the event.
